job.rawJd:
General recruiter and networking profile, not an employer posting.

Target: Product Manager, Senior Product Manager, Product Strategy Lead, and adjacent client-facing product roles.

Core work: understand customer and business problems; lead discovery; translate needs into product decisions, requirements, priorities, and roadmaps; align stakeholders and cross-functional teams; guide iterative delivery; and improve products through user feedback, adoption signals, and measurable outcomes.

Resume architecture: lead with direct product strategy and ownership across One Block Away, Hedgehox, and Kinesso. Use UX as evidence of customer discovery and product judgment. Consolidate earlier account leadership as evidence of client understanding, commercial context, and cross-functional delivery. Keep AI as a product-building capability rather than the primary identity.

This package must be fit-gated again against each employer's actual job description before application.
